verdict.rationale: Box's docs show broad API coverage mirroring most core UI features—uploads, sharing, collaborations, search, metadata, webhooks, events, e-signature, and AI—suggesting substantial API/UI parity (box-docs-2 through box-docs-10, box-docs-19-22). However, there's no explicit vendor claim of full UI-API parity, no independent verification, and no evidence covering admin-console-only settings or newer AI/agent features being fully API-exposed (openapi spec itself 404s, box-probe-2). Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, independent/hands-on confirmation, and coverage of admin/enterprise-console-specific capabilities via API.
